headline: Approved return of contributions, retirement applications, and disability retirement application for multiple employees.
summary: The board approved the minutes of its August 24, 2026 meeting. It approved returns of contributions for six employees, nine retirement applications, and one disability retirement application. The board also received an August Investment Report from Fiducient.
decisions: Approved the August 24, 2026 Retirement Board Meeting Minutes as presented.

Approved return of contributions for Kevin C. Kane ($1,927.47), Ryan N. Hayes ($8,131.35), Ratna A. Polk ($3,973.71), Ratna Polk ($1,546.19), Arie Van Vuuren ($33,189.74), and Nicholas M. Chmura ($16,082.74).

Approved retirement applications for Fikret Muminovic, Jacqueline Langlois, Robert J. Barclay, Larry T. Hammond, Gwenn Robinson, Christopher R. Burns, Dwight E. Brown, Gordon M. Bennett III, and Raymond Piche, Jr.
Approved disability retirement application for Sergio N. Caldieri, Class A $5,304.98.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Matson, to approve the minutes as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Parker, to approve the return of contributions as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Dalla Mura, to approve the retirement applications as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Dalla Mura, seconded by Board Member Kasti, to approve the disability retirement application as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
